name: FTSE 100
summary: FTSE 100 near 10,699 on 27 Nov, 2.1% higher on the week and 1.9% below its 52-week high
state: The FTSE 100 closed near 10,699 on 27 Nov, 1.9% below its 52-week high of about 10,911 and inside the 5% Normal line (Yahoo Finance). It rose 2.1% over the week, and its worst day in five sessions was -0.4%, well inside the 2.5% line.
for_you: UK shares are trading close to their highs, so there is no sign of market stress feeding through to UK pensions or savings linked to the index.
why: The UK's main index — a gauge of UK-listed multinationals, pensions and sterling-area sentiment.
drivers: Commodity prices, sterling, global risk appetite, UK policy and banking sector news.
